bot.name: Hospital Full Automation
bot.description: Healthcare operations automation template for hospital front desk, appointments, lab, billing, insurance, admission, emergency routing, and human handover.

messages.text: Welcome to {{hospital_name}}. I can help with appointments, doctor availability, lab reports, billing, insurance, admissions, health packages, and connecting you to the hospital team. For emergencies, call {{emergency_phone}} immediately.

messages: Choose your preferred language.

messages.text: I will continue in English. You can still type your request in the language you prefer.

messages: Tell me what you need today, for example: book an appointment, check a report, ask about billing, request an ambulance, or speak with the hospital team.

messages.text: I can help with vaccination information, eligibility, pricing, and booking support.

messages: Share vaccination request details.

messages.text: Your vaccination request has been received. The hospital team will confirm eligibility, stock, and next available slot.
I can help start a second opinion request. Please do not use this chat for emergencies.

messages: Share patient and second opinion details.

messages.text: Your second opinion request has been received. A suitable specialist review path will be arranged.
I can help with procedure information, required tests, cost-estimate requests, or scheduling a consultation.
